verdict.rationale: Brave Search API is a REST API accessed via simple curl/HTTP calls with an API key, making it inherently scriptable and CI-friendly; it also ships an official MCP server and integration guides (n8n, Dify, OpenClaw) for headless automation/agentic workflows. missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example/docs (e.g., GitHub Actions), and no independent hands-on report confirming headless CI usage.
